C2.1.quote: an evaluation profile on (N, X) collects the evaluations of the electorate

C2.2.quote: Each agent i ∈ N can either approve of an option
C2.2.note: Binary 0/1 evaluation for each option, equivalent to an approval set.

C2.3.quote: agents who are indifferent to all the options
C2.3.note: Attitude language (opinions, indifference) is used, but it is not defined separately from the evaluations.

C2.4.quote: members of a group express binary (i.e., yes-no, approval-disapproval) opinions
C2.4.note: Evaluations and opinions are treated as one object, and nothing is said about reporting. ONE would fit if 'evaluations' were read purely as ballots.

C6.VOT.reason: The codebook counts a type as present when its actions are fixed, and voters' approve/disapprove evaluations are such fixed actions, so VOT is present and NONSTRAT (implicit).
